title: 多头注意力：拆头/合并维度变换
expected_output:
输入形状: (1, 6, 12)  头数: 3  每头维度 d_k: 4
拆头后形状: (1, 3, 6, 4) (B, heads, T, d_k)
合并回形状: (1, 6, 12)
合并误差(应=0): 0.0
d_model 必须被 heads 整除 -> d_k 为整数: True
code:
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(3)
B, T, E = 1, 6, 12
heads = 3
d_k = E // heads
x = np.random.randn(B, T, E)
print("输入形状:", x.shape, " 头数:", heads, " 每头维度 d_k:", d_k)
xh = x.reshape(B, T, heads, d_k).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)   # (B, heads, T, d_k)
print("拆头后形状:", xh.shape, "(B, heads, T, d_k)")
merged = xh.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, T, E)
print("合并回形状:", merged.shape)
print("合并误差(应=0):", float(np.max(np.abs(merged - x))))
print("d_model 必须被 heads 整除 -> d_k 为整数:", bool(E % heads == 0))
